TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Rejects the creation of a pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: The transaction obtains pricingRuleId from the request with getPricingruleid(); if the parameter is null or cannot be converted to Long, getPricingruleid() returns null and the same null value is sent to ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId). Inside the library, PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId) retrieves the pricing rule, RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails(rule, pricingRuleId, repository, queriesMap) loads its active details and resolves each detail value, and PricingRuleValidator.validateReject(rule, pricingRuleId) verifies that a rule exists and that its status is PAA, PAU or PAD. 2. Decisions and branches: In fillDetailValues(details, queriesMap), if queriesMap has no query for a detail entity type, if the resolved detail value is null or blank, or if queryForString(...) raises NoResultException, the flow throws PricingRuleException ABKO10010004. In validateReject(rule, pricingRuleId), if rule is null the flow throws ABKO10000405; if rule.getStatus() is not PAA, PAU or PAD it throws ABKO10000412. In processRejection(rule, status, pricingRuleId, auditId, auditUserId, repository), if status is PAA or PAU the rule status is changed to REJ; if status is PAD the rule status is changed to SYC. 3. Libraries and methods invoked: The transaction calls ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId); that method uses PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId), RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails(rule, pricingRuleId, repository, queriesMap), PricingRuleValidator.validateReject(rule, pricingRuleId), PricingRuleRepository.getNextId(QueryConstants.GET_AUDIT_LOG_ID_SEQUENCE), PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit(auditId, EntityTypeEnum.PRL.getDbValue(), ruleId, DbConstants.UPDATE_OPERATION_ACRONYM, auditUserId), and PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus(ruleId, newStatus.getDbValue(), auditId, auditUserId). 4. Errors and subsequent actions: executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId) catches PricingRuleException, converts it into addAdviceWithDescription(e.getCode(), e.getDescription()) and returns null; back in the transaction, assignSeverityError(getAdviceList()) sets Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. updatePricingRuleStatus(id, status, auditId, auditUserId) throws ABKO00000010 with description "Update for approving/disapproving pricing rule with ID {id} status in the database failed" when the update result is 0. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: When the library returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, setPricingrule(field) writes it to pricingRuleResponse; when the returned DTO is null, setPricingrule(field) skips the output assignment.
